FIRST INFORMATION REPORT

FIR Number: FIR No. 47/2026

Police Station: Shivaji Nagar Police Station

Jurisdiction: Pune City

Date of registration: 14 August 2026

Complainant: Neha Patil

Date/time of occurrence: 14 August 2026 at 20:35

Place of occurrence: Senapati Road junction, Pune

Vehicle involved: MH-12-AB-4821

Accused named in complaint: Rohan Mehta

Victim: Amit Kulkarni

Brief facts: On the stated date and time, a road traffic collision occurred at the junction. The complainant states that the accused was driving the identified vehicle when it struck the pedestrian victim.

The victim was taken to a nearby hospital for treatment. The complainant requested investigation of the incident.
